title: Spark Spray (Leizu LMB, refs D2 Charged Bolt + PoE2 Spark)
palette: Endesga 32 (sprites alpha 0/255); masks white-on-transparent, 6 alpha levels
mechanics: v2b: 3-5 sparks leave the tail tip in a fan (+-30/40 deg), 3.3 px/frame (100 px/s), life 34-40 f. Chaotic motion (VH): zigzag heading kicks every few frames, crawl along the ground, reflect off walls. MOCKUP stand-in: kick +-35..75 deg alternating side every 3-5 f with 30 % pull back to the aim, 1 px hop jitter, velocity reflected at wall faces. Hit box |dx|<9, |dy|<6 (v1).
spawn: Per spark each frame: spark_dir16 at (x, y-4) (crawl: optional 1 px hop), row = rowof(vx, vy) of the CURRENT velocity, loop frame = (age / 50 ms + spark index x 3) mod 8 regardless of row; spark_ground at (x, y), same frame index.
Trail: spark_trail at the positions 1, 3 and 5 frames back, once.
Wall bounce: spark_spray_bounce + spark_spray_bounce_flash at the contact point on the wall face (x, wall ground y - 4), frame 0 on the bounce frame. Omni, no rotation needed.
Hit: spark_hit + spark_hit_flash at (x, enemy chest y = feet-16); spark_hit_ground at (x, enemy feet).
No hit at end of life: spark_fizzle at (x, y-4); spark_fizzle_scorch at (x, y) starting 1 frame later.
changes_v2b: v2b (VH mechanic change, 2026-11-19): sparks move chaotically - zigzag, crawl on the ground, bounce off walls; code orients the art per frame along the CURRENT velocity.

`spark_spray_spark_dir16` REPLACED: head ~11 px (crackle ball, flickering core 1.5/1.9 px) + 2-3 crackly omni filaments re-seeded every frame + a SHORT 7-11 px streak (was 18-24 px). Head and filaments are identical in all 16 rows for a given frame index, only the streak turns, so the row swap at each heading change / bounce never pops. Still dir16 (pick the row from velocity every frame; keep the loop frame counter running across row swaps). Frame 28 x 28 (was 52 x 53), pivot (14, 13) = head centre.
NEW `spark_spray_bounce` (+ glow) and `spark_spray_bounce_flash`: wall-bounce pop at the contact point.
Trail drops reduced to k = 1, 3, 5 frames behind (shorter streak, jittery path). Other spark strips unchanged.

base.sort: y-sorted with actors: key = ground y + offset given per strip
base.curve: frames as baked (no extra fade; fades are dissolves in the art)

glow.material: additive (One One), unlit, mask alpha x tint x gain, two passes: inner (small blur, near-white) + outer (wide blur, blue)
glow.sort: same sort key as its base strip + 1 (draws right after it)
glow.curve: frame-matched to the base; loops: x(0.85-1.15) per-frame flicker

ground.material: additive (One One) on the FLOOR sorting layer, below actors and decals-on-top
ground.sort: floor layer, above floor decals, below every actor
ground.curve: baked per frame; loops: x(0.8-1.2) flicker

flash.material: additive (One One), unlit, drawn on the top FX layer above actors; optional full-screen add = mean(mask) x screen gain
flash.sort: top FX layer (above actors and other FX)
flash.curve: baked per frame (impact frame first); screen flash 1 frame peak then 0

heat.material: screen-space distortion (grab pass / opaque texture): uv += (noise2D(uv*k + t) - 0.5) * mask * amp_px / screen_px; never drawn
heat.sort: after transparent FX, before the CRT post
heat.curve: baked per frame; scroll noise at ~6 Hz

decal.material: alpha-blend cutout on the FLOOR sorting layer (opaque dark pixels, dissolves by frame)
decal.sort: floor layer, below the ground light and actors
decal.curve: frames as baked, hold the last frame 0 ms (strip ends empty-ish)

spark_spray_spark_dir16.note: v2b chaotic-motion spark: rotation-safe head (same in every row) + short crackly streak opposite to the CURRENT velocity; pick row = rowof(vx, vy) every frame, keep the loop frame index running across row swaps
